faq.question: How do I sign in?
faq.answer: Use your Google account. Your email and Google profile remain read-only; you can save a separate nickname in Profile.

faq.question: Are my files uploaded?
faq.answer: Browser-local video and image utilities process files on your device. Background Remover uses cloud AI processing and uploads the selected image when you start the job.

faq.question: When are AI credits used?
faq.answer: Background Remover reserves one credit when processing starts. A successful result consumes the reservation; a provider failure refunds it. Browser-local tools do not use AI credits.

faq.question: How do reward codes work?
faq.answer: Enter a valid code in Redeem Code. Each account can redeem a code once, before its expiry and while uses remain. Rewards add promotional credits, not cash or a subscription.

faq.question: Can I buy a subscription now?
faq.answer: Paid checkout is not available yet. No action in this account center starts a subscription or charges a card.
